t decisions at Longview are made by our Investment Committee. Simple, not easy. We manage a single, global portfolio of stocks, the Longview Portfolio. Our investment strategy is as follows: We buy shares in high quality companies when their stock market values are below our estimate of their economic value. We think long term — like business owners, not traders — hoping to own the companies we buy for many years. We have a disciplined, repeatable investment process designed to keep bias and emotion out of our decision-making.
